title.narrative: 22F-EAGC - Enhancing irrigation to improve climate adaptation and sustain small holder production systems in Uganda

description.narrative: DGBP 2022. Enhancing irrigation to improve climate adaptation and sustain small holder production systems in Uganda

The overall goal of the project is to reduce climate vulnerabilities and increase sustainability of smallholder food production systems to improve livelihoods of smallholder farmers by enhancing availability and adoption of smart irrigation solutions and climate adaptation practices within an inclusive ecosystem of private sector driven services. The interventions focus on building knowledge and capacity, while supporting private sector driven business models including technology, finance to invest in quality irrigation solutions and produce markets.
The Danida Green Business Partnerships (DGBP) programme funds and supports market-based partnership projects between commercial and non-commercial partners addressing climate and environmental challenges while contributing to inclusive growth and improved livelihoods. The programme builds on previous years’ experience with the private partnership program, DMDP.
